title: Summer Games (Atari 2600/CPC/Master System/Spectrum)
description:
Originally released in the 1980s for many home computers and consoles, this classic sports game saw players compete in a wide variety of athletic events. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Contains the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, Atari 2600, and Sega Master System versions.GameplayCompete in a number of athletic events, including:
• Pole vault

• Diving

• 4 × 400 m relay

• 100 m dash

• Gymnastics

• Freestyle relay swimming

• 100 m freestyle swimming

• Skeet shooting

This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

• Saving/loading the game at any point

• Support for most modern game controllers

• Full control remapping

• Image scaling and smoothing options
description_short: Compete in a wide variety of athletic events in this classic game from the 1980s, including pole vault, gymnastics, 100 m dash, and skeet shooting. Included are the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, Atari 2600 and Sega Master System versions.
